name: DataOrbit business operating model
description: How it runs Altitudes each at its own cadence

workflows.name: Revenue
workflows.job: roll up the equation is revenue on plan?
workflows.state_rule: nominal: no red-tier exposure with a named open item on revenue_accounting; ARR pace vs target_arr is carried by the objective banner, not by state

workflows.name: Cash
workflows.job: roll up the equation is revenue on plan?
workflows.state_rule: nominal: no red-tier exposure with a named open item on cash_accounting; AR ageing 100% inside the 0-30 day bucket

workflows.name: New Revenue
workflows.state_rule: nominal: no red-tier exposure with a named open item on new_business; acv-vs-target pace is carried by the card delta, not by state

workflows.name: Retention Revenue
workflows.state_rule: warm: red_tier_arr $2.2M of the $12.0M book (18.3%) with open_renewal Meridian $0.8M deciding Dec 16 — inside the 30-day renewal window

workflows.name: Expansion Revenue
workflows.state_rule: nominal: no red-tier exposure with a named open item on expansion

workflows.name: Churn Revenue
workflows.state_rule: nominal: open_at_risk $0.8M carries no account/deadline fields — the same Meridian exposure is flagged on retention; save-rate-vs-target pace is carried by the card delta, not by state

altitudes.name: Flows
altitudes.note: each flow runs under its lever

flows.name: Lead-to-Cash
flows.state_rule: nominal: no red-tier exposure with a named open item on new_business; coverage-vs-threshold is pace, not exposure

flows.name: Renewal-to-Cash
flows.state_rule: warm: red_tier_arr $2.2M with open_renewal Meridian $0.8M, decision Dec 16 — inside the 30-day renewal window

flows.name: Quote-to-Cash
flows.state_rule: nominal: no red-tier exposure with a named open item on expansion

flows.name: Risk-to-Resolution
flows.state_rule: nominal: open_at_risk $0.8M has no account/deadline fields — the same Meridian exposure is flagged on Renewal-to-Cash, not double-counted here
